title: Quick check: Number, Date, and Specialized Inputs

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Number, Date, and Specialized Inputs”?
options: Number fields should provide labels, validation feedback, and a recoverable input experience.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
questions.answer_key: Number fields should provide labels, validation feedback, and a recoverable input experience.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Number, Date, and Specialized Inputs: Number fields should provide labels, validation feedback, and a recoverable input experience.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Number fields?
options: Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Keep useful values on validation failure and associate each input with a label and error message.
questions.answer_key: Keep useful values on validation failure and associate each input with a label and error message.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Number, Date, and Specialized Inputs: Keep useful values on validation failure and associate each input with a label and error message.

Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Number, Date, and Specialized Inputs: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
